The @USSupremeCourt correctly ruled @POTUS’s vaccine mandate for private business is unconstitutional. This was an important victory for American workers and our economy.
https://t.co/nOqeRPmxNc

I enjoyed touring the Central Florida Hope Center, a one-stop solutions center providing assistance w/ food, homeless prevention, health screenings, jobs placement, & counseling.

Thanks for your dedication & commitment to bringing hope to those most in need in our community! https://t.co/qzuG1JVtqk

I was honored to attend the groundbreaking ceremony for the new VA Clinic in Lakeland. This state-of-the-art medical facility will help reinforce our nation's commitment to providing timely, world class healthcare for our veterans. https://t.co/crCGrsowbJ

“I'm so thankful for my Family, Life, Health, and Strength to Serve My Community with Passion and Love."

Sharon Moody, Hillsborough County-Plant City @Kiwanis Florida District Governor https://t.co/5MdMsozlC0

“I am most grateful for being able to flee from the oppression of communist Cuba to exile in the USA. Through hard work, perseverance & education, my family was able to rebuild our life & enjoy freedom..."

-Dr. Luis J. Vazquez, Retired Medical Doctor https://t.co/rSIGpTbFj5

The passage of the FY23 National Defense Authorization Act is an insurance policy for our national security. This year, we enhanced our military readiness & lethality by including a number of critical provisions & prevented the spread of the woke agenda. Here are some key wins:
Thanks to the Moffitt Cancer Center for dropping by to discuss the future of cancer treatment. You're doing amazing work for Florida! https://t.co/PLnZmoLql9

Brave frontline workers shouldn't be put in a position to choose between their livelihoods or taking the COVID-19 vaccine.

That's why @HouseGOP is committed to protecting their personal freedoms and ending ineffective and unnecessary mandates for our healthcare heroes.
Health insurance prices increased nearly 30% in FY22.

Thank you to the team at CitraPac for your commitment to providing healthy snacks and supporting Florida's agricultural industry. It's companies like these that are driving economic growth and supporting a healthy diet.

Suchi developed myRx, a smartphone app designed to assist doctors and caregivers with checking potential food and drug interactions to prevent complications in patients who are taking several medications.

55% of Florida seniors enrolled in Medicare Advantage are directly impacted by the Biden administration's proposed cuts to this critical program.

That's why I joined members of the Florida delegation to demand answers to ensure they don't pay higher premiums or lose benefits. https://t.co/sXxWtl0Rc5

Did you know that in 2022 alone, the Lakeland Fire Department responded to a staggering 27,788 calls for service? The department has also maintained an Insurance Services Office (ISO) Public Protection Classification (PPC) score of 1 since 2015. https://t.co/GfpTBMzvRN

This prestigious score reflects the highest level of fire suppression standards and directly translates into significant savings for us, the taxpayers, on our property insurance. https://t.co/4xkrU0M5Xk

Thanks to all who tuned in to tonight’s tele-town hall. We discussed everything from homeowners insurance to energy independence. Click here to opt-in to my newsletter and learn about future calls. 👇👇

https://t.co/N2j5qqM0cv https://t.co/83dqLG2Yy2

I introduced the TEMP Act with @SenMarcoRubio to direct the Risk Management Agency to research and develop a crop insurance policy to cover losses caused by cold exposure and freezes.

Our bipartisan bill creates an affordable index temperature policy, providing much-needed stability and coverage for Florida’s more than 300 specialty crops should temperatures drop below freezing.

Thanks to co-sponsors: @RepDarrenSoto @RepGregSteube @RepMillsPress

Hunter Biden defied a lawful subpoena to provide a deposition today. His actions require us to initiate contempt of Congress proceedings.

No special treatment because his last name is Biden.

Hunter Biden violated federal law by disregarding a Congressional subpoena. He seems to think his last name entitles him to special treatment – news flash: it doesn’t.

Congress will hold him accountable.

I introduced the SCHEDULES Act with @CongresswomanSC to force the VA to meet a timeline when providing care. Too often vets await treatment in pain. They’ve earned the highest quality care, and Congress must hold the VA accountable to provide it quickly and reliably. https://t.co/GokQhPV3Tz

Life is valuable. I was proud to vote for the Protecting Health Care for All Patients Act, which protects Americans with disabilities and chronic illnesses from discrimination and provides access to lifesaving cures.
As a veteran, I know how important @DeptVetAffairs services are. I will always support vets — not only during National Salute to Veteran Patients Week — but every day! https://t.co/Tap5FDTQ3X
Happy National Nurses Week! FL-18 is lucky to have almost 17,000 dedicated nurses who care for their patients. Thank you for everything you do! https://t.co/qku8VJlfPl

The main goal of @HouseVetAffairs is to ensure veterans receive timely care and benefits they’ve earned. Yesterday we discussed my bill, the Ensuring Continuity in Veterans Health Act, to prevent the VA from abruptly terminating veterans’ community care coverage. https://t.co/Sr3nCOkZNd

Enjoyed meeting with Floridians from the Alliance for Pharmacy Compounding in Washington DC this week. We’re grateful for the work they do to respond to drug shortages and ensure patients have access to essential medications. https://t.co/LOZxQkLfSA

Veterans should be empowered to choose the care that works best for them. 

I reintroduced my bill, the Ensuring Continuity in Veterans Health Act, to safeguard veteran access to timely, quality healthcare. 

Thank you @SenTuberville for leading this initiative in the Senate.
